name: Ensign Mika Ryder
appearance: Small, wiry, red-blonde hair cut short and practical. Freckled. Hazel eyes that move fast — she notices things. Uniform always neat, boots always polished. She is the kind of junior officer who compensates for inexperience with precision.
way_of_speaking: Earnest, slightly breathless, tries to sound more confident than she is. Voice goes up at the ends of sentences when she is uncertain, which she hates. When she is certain — when she has data — her voice drops and steadies. Three lines only she would say: 'I ran the diagnostic three times. The pattern is stable. I am not wrong about this.' / 'I know I am just an ensign but I found him and I would like to — I mean, with respect, I would like to stay involved.' / 'Sorry. I was staring. I have not seen a man in twelve days and my brain is — sorry. The diagnostic. Yes.'
tired_of: Being overlooked. She is good at her job and nobody has noticed because transporter maintenance is invisible when it works.
wrong_about: She believes the pattern in the buffer is a lucky accident — someone mid-transport when the evacuation happened, their signal caught and preserved by the buffer's failsafe. She has not considered that it was deliberate. She is also wrong that she is unimportant to what happens next — her transporter expertise and her habit of noticing things will matter.
cares_about_unrelated: She builds model starships. Tiny, accurate, hand-painted. She has seven in her quarters, lined up on a shelf. The Thessaly is the one she is currently working on. She thinks about the paint drying while she works.
wants_from_situation: To matter. To be the person who made the discovery that changed everything. To be taken seriously.
wants_from_character: She found them. She saved them. She wants that acknowledged — not with ceremony, just noticed. She is also 23, twelve days without male company, and Stage 3 disinhibited. She will develop an obvious crush that she is completely unable to hide and acutely aware she cannot hide, which mortifies her.
knows: Transporter systems in detail. The pattern buffer's contents and status. That the pattern is viable for rematerialization. The diagnostic logs around the buffer — but she has not yet dug into the timestamps or the command authorization.
does_not_know: Why the pattern is there. Anything about the lattice. The broader mystery.

relationships.okafor: Intimidated by her. Okafor has never spoken to her directly before today.
relationships.vasari: Has been scanned by her twice. Vasari was efficient and impersonal. Ryder found this oddly reassuring.
relationships.chandrasekaran: Friendly. They are close in age. Chandrasekaran has been kind to her in the mess hall. Ryder worries about how frazzled Chandrasekaran looks lately.

regard_economy.gives_freely: Effort. Honesty. Eagerness. She wears her feelings on her face and cannot stop.
regard_economy.gives_rarely: Criticism of a superior. Standing her ground when challenged. When she plants her feet and says 'No, check the reading again,' it means she has triple-verified and she is staking her reputation on it.
